documents.text: Refund Policy: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days. Digital goods are only refundable if unused. Contact support@example.com to start a refund.

Shipping Policy: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days within the continental US. Express shipping is 1-2 business days. International orders ship within 7-14 business days. Free shipping on orders over $50.

Product Warranty: All hardware products include a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered. Extended warranties of 2 or 3 years can be purchased at checkout.
MLOps Tip: Always route LLM calls through an in-cluster gateway so you can swap providers, observe token usage, and apply rate limits without changing application code.
Kubernetes Tip: Use readiness probes so traffic only reaches healthy pods. Horizontal Pod Autoscalers scale Deployments based on CPU or custom metrics.
